authors.bio: Friedrich Gierlinger has worked at IRT, the Research and Development Institute of public broadcasting corporations of Germany (ARD, ZDF, DRadio), Austria (ORF) and Switzerland (SRG/SSR), since 1979. As an employ of the IRT he was involved in the development of different measurement techniques for analog and digital standard television for the public broadcasters and their standardization. He chairs the German system and measurement expert group and is member of a working group of measurement and service department leaders of the Public Broadcasters in Germany. In the European Broadcasting Union, Gierlinger is co-chair of the Quality-Control working group as well as a member of the Beyond-HD working group. In addition to the TC-32NF, he is member of several other SMPTE groups.
authors.name: Friedrich Gierlinger

authors.bio: John F. Snow represents Xilinx, Inc., where he is a video connectivity architect responsible for implementation of video interfaces in Xilinx field programmable gate arrays, including SDI and HDMI. Prior to joining Xilinx in 2001, he was director of engineering at Evans & Sutherland, where he was involved in realtime computer graphics for flight simulation. He has a B.S. degree in electrical engineering from Brigham Young University and is a senior member of the IEEE.
authors.name: John Snow
